one_month_reasoning: One scheduled event in the window: Q3 2026 results Tue 2026-11-10 before the open (call 8:30am ET) [21]. Guide: sales 36-37, non-GAAP GM 46.5-47.5%, opex 24-25, EPS -0.20 to -0.12 [5]; Street 36.6 / -0.19 [12]. The company beat the top of its sales range 4/4 since the IPO (median +8.4% vs midpoint) and the EPS range 4/4; I expect ~38 and EPS about -0.12, so another beat is likely. What moves the stock is the Q4 guide and 2027 colour: Q4 is supply-constrained (unmet short-lead-time orders [20], H2 "constrained by available supply" [17]), the FY ~$135M guide implies Q4 ~39.5, and Street Q4 is 39.6 [12], so the bar is not low. The stock fell from ~$68 (Oct 2) to $43.31 with no company release; EDGAR shows 16 Form 144 notices from Aug 14 to Oct 5 after the 60-day follow-on lock-up ended (~Aug 23) [25,24], so part of the drop is insider/holder supply plus AI-semis sentiment (beta 1.23 to SMH [34]), which leaves room for a relief move on a clean print. Net (round 2): the stock closed at $44.68 on 11-03 (run notes), so the median moves to ~$45.2 (the 11-03 close plus ~1% for post-beat drift; no new 8-K on EDGAR as of 11-04 [24]); lognormal sigma 0.25 (monthly vol 0.82/3.5 = 0.234, widened for the print). The supervisor's findings concern the 12-month multiple basis, not the window, so the ladder only moves for the new close.

key_uncertainties: Customer concentration: top-3 end customers 78% of Q2 26 sales (71% in Q1); no binding purchase commitments [6,8].

Whether the 2026 step-up is end demand or channel build: management says lean channel inventory and expedites [17], but AMBQ's own purchase commitments rose from $7.7M to $32.2M and inventories from $16.9M to $29.4M in six months [6].
Opex discipline vs the breakeven promise: management pulled breakeven toward 2H27-early 2028 at ~$47M/qtr [20], then said it is too early to time profitability [17]; IP purchases are recurring.
Supply: sole wafer source and tight OSAT/substrate capacity cap H2 2026 revenue [6,17].
Executive bonuses are discretionary with no disclosed revenue or profit metric (2026 proxy), so the breakeven target is not tied to pay.
Peer set is thin (5); LSCC 2027 sales consensus looks inflated; MCU incumbents trade on different economics.

reasoning: Lane: primary documents (filings, releases, call transcripts, IR decks, Form 144/EDGAR index, proxy). I started from the thread quarterly driver set and checked each driver against the company's own words. Revenue: FY26 guide ~$135M [18]; 4/4 quarterly beats (median +8.4%) but H2 explicitly supply-constrained and orders unmet [20,17]; purchase commitments 7.6 -> 27.7 -> 32.2 [27,6] support demand; so I keep us/cn/row and the FY26 138.5 (+2.6% vs guide). GM: keep (modest y/y gains per Q2 call, sole-source costs). Opex: I differ from the set (+14/11/10% vs +22/14/12%) because management framed breakeven at ~$47M/qtr in 2H27-early 2028 [20] and opex landed at/below guide twice [4,5]; recurring IP purchases (7-10M/yr, ~2M in Q3) [17] keep it from being flat. In the EV/sales leg this matters only ~$0.3/sh, so the value is driven by revenue and the multiple. Loss-making through FY28, so P/E and EV/EBITDA cannot carry it; Round 2: the supervisor showed my round-1 multiple was on the wrong basis (own 3.98x on basic shares and CY27 consensus; peers on CY27 rather than NTM). Rebuilt on one basis: 5 genuine peers on EV / Nov-26..Oct-27 sales (median 4.39x, range 3.57-10.71x), own 4.87x on 27.97M fully diluted shares, k = 0.8 -> 4.77x; plus $16.2M interest on net cash that the engine omits. Result $45.52 (from $39.77). I keep my opex path (only $0.28/sh) and the thread revenue/GM drivers, which the supervisor also kept; agent_3's sell-in concern (inventories 16.9 -> 29.4, receivables 7.3 -> 17.5 [6]) was already in my downside. Moratorium expected effect -$0.27/sh booked once. Scenarios move the named drivers (customer loss / inventory correction / China / GM incl. ASP pressure; supply relief, design wins, mix) and the multiple to ~2.62x / ~7.32x: P10 $25.28, P90 $73.29. New primary findings beyond the recaps: top-3 concentration rose to 78% from 71%; inventories +73% in six months; the October slide followed the end of the 60-day follow-on lock-up and 16 Form 144s; bonuses are discretionary; FY26 opex guide includes IP purchases while the cash-flow statement also capitalises intangibles (possible double count, flagged). Research was limited to ~15 web queries/fetches plus EDGAR.

model_inputs.ebit_basis_note: EBIT = company non-GAAP gross profit - non-GAAP operating expense - D&A = GAAP loss from operations + SBC + severance + IPO-related bonus and transaction costs - the 2025 non-monetary gain (Ex.99.1 reconciliations). Q2 2026: -8.727 + 3.557 = -5.170 = 15.989 - 19.374 - 1.785 [5]. The company's own non-GAAP figures exclude D&A as well as SBC, so its "non-GAAP operating loss" (GP - opex) is EBITDA-like; this set deducts D&A to keep EBIT an EBIT (engine ebitda = ebit + da = the company figure). EPS in notes = company non-GAAP net loss per share (excl. SBC and D&A, incl. other income) on weighted basic shares, the basis of the guide and Street (StockAnalysis/Benzinga). Engine model EPS = EBIT / diluted shares (no other income) and is lower; Zacks figures are on a different, GAAP-like basis.

model_inputs.gap_note: (1) Opex path is my judgment (thread +22% FY27 vs mine +14%): only -$0.28/sh in the engine because the EV/sales leg reads revenue, not profit; the profitability path matters through the multiple. (2) Basis: company non-GAAP opex includes "$7-10M of IP purchases" while the cash-flow statement capitalises "purchase of intangible assets" ($5.1M H1 26) that the set carries in capex_c: possible double count of up to ~$5M/yr (~$0.2/sh); flagged, not changed. (3) Shares: 27.97M fully diluted (treasury method) is now used for both the own multiple and the bridge (round 2, supervisor finding); 24.52M is the basic count (Form 144, Oct 2). Peer EVs stay on their reported share counts. (4) Financing: no S-3/ATM on file and cash ~$357M covers the burn; P(equity raise by the horizon) ~15% (two follow-ons in 12 months were opportunistic), below 20%, so no financing_event. (5) Take-out: TI/SLAB at ~$7.5B [16] is context only; no cited evidence of interest in AMBQ, p = 0. (6) LSCC 2027 sales +60% on MarketScreener looks inflated; LSCC is the top of the set on any basis, so it does not move the median. Multiple sensitivity: each 0.1x of exit EV/sales = $0.72/sh; supervisor median 4.45x -> 4.79x ~$45.66. (7) Opex: I keep my lower path vs the set (+$0.28/sh). (8) Interest income +16.2 added as an adjustment because the engine roll earns nothing on net cash.
